name: book_appointment
description: Create a fictional appointment with Dr. Elena Voss only after the caller explicitly confirms the dentist, date, and time. Pass the confirmed slot ID from check_availability and a fictional patient name. Do not collect phone, email, payment, or medical information. Do not call this to guess a slot or to ask for another verbal confirmation after a successful or replayed booking.

slot_id.description: Stable slot ID returned by check_availability (for example SLOT-002). This is the confirmed date and time.

patient_name.description: Fictional patient name only. Do not send a phone number, email address, or medical details.

dentist_name.description: Dentist the caller confirmed. Must be Dr. Elena Voss.

confirmed.description: True only after the caller explicitly confirmed dentist, date, and time. Do not call this function when confirmed is false.
